Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Nov 23–27). Times I have free (working hours):

- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30

Would any of these work for you, or is there another slot in your week I should fit around? Thanks!
Hi Sarah — Mon 10:00–10:30 works for me, but let me confirm against the department's official schedule for that week before I book it. I'll come back to you shortly.

Hello — this is Professor Alvarez. Could you send me the official schedule (lectures, seminars and university meetings) for next week, Nov 23–27, so I can place my student meetings around it? Thank you.

Hi Sarah — I'm Professor Alvarez, teaching CSE455. Got your message about the 1:1.

Mon 10:00–10:30 looks the best of the four; I'll confirm it as soon as I have the department's official schedule for that week in front of me, so I don't put you on top of something of theirs.

If anything changes, I'll write again within the hour.
Great, Mon 10:00–10:30 works on my side too. I'll hold it and wait to hear back from you — if it clashes with the department's schedule I can offer another slot. Thanks!
